name: Dev Workflow Skills
author: HereLiesAz
description: Six agent skills for everyday software engineering workflows: conventional commits, changelog writing, TDD, SQL query optimization, API contract design, and blameless incident postmortems.

skills.name: Conventional Commits
skills.description: Write Conventional Commits-formatted commit messages and validate existing ones.

skills.name: Changelog Writer
skills.description: Draft a CHANGELOG entry or release notes from a range of commits, merged PRs, or a diff.

skills.name: TDD Workflow
skills.description: Implement a feature or fix a bug using strict red-green-refactor test-driven development.

skills.name: SQL Query Optimizer
skills.description: Analyze and optimize a slow SQL query using its execution plan.

skills.name: API Contract Design
skills.description: Design an API contract (REST/OpenAPI, GraphQL, or RPC) before implementation, or review an existing one.

skills.name: Incident Postmortem
skills.description: Write a blameless postmortem for a production incident from a timeline, logs, or a description of what happened.
